messages:
Emma L.: FYI — CloudChannel LLC sent invoice 43021 for Feb usage (AWS Marketplace). Vendor amount $12,342.50 but our metered report shows $9,876.25. They claim seats were billed as reseller SKUs, undercounting on our side. Attaching CSV excerpt and PDF: /files/43021.pdf

Ben (FIN): Can you drop the invoice number + the CSV excerpt here? I'll run a quick reconciliation. Any PO or contract override?

Emma L.: Invoice 43021, vendor ref CC-02-2026. CSV excerpt:```sku,usage_units,unit_price,amount
redwood.prod.standard,8200,0.0012,9.84
redwood.reseller.pilot,1200,0.0022,2.64
TOTAL,9400,,12.48```They claim the 1200 units should've mapped to our seat-commit (lower price) not reseller SKU.

Sasha - PartnerOps: CloudChannel is a reseller pilot in EMEA. They requested a temporary pricing override on 2026-02-05 (PO #CC-PILOT-01). I thought the override only applied to invoiced seat charges, not marketplace meters. Did we document that?

Raj - Revenue: Right — the pilot discount was applied to direct seat invoices, we didn’t propagate a marketplace SKU mapping change to AWS product codes. Looks like AWS continued to meter under the reseller SKU, hence the delta. We should calculate the delta and issue a credit if confirmed.

Noah (Acct): Put AP hold on 43021 until resolution. Need approved credit amount + GL code to process.

invoice-bot: Payment hold placed on invoice 43021 — reason: dispute. AP ticket AP-2026-112 created.

Ben (FIN): I ran a quick calc. If the 1200 units map to seat-commit price (0.0010) vs reseller (0.0022), credit = (0.0022-0.0010)*1200 = $1.44. But vendor invoice difference is larger (~$2,466.25). Need full line-level match. Emma — can you export the full meter lines for Feb (all SKUs, timestamps)?

Emma L.: Export attached: /files/cc_feb_meterlines.csv. Quick diff shows additional 1,760 units billed under an old SKU mapping (redwood.prod.old_retail) that we retired Feb 1 — looks like AWS product mapping lagged. Combined delta across SKUs = $2,466.25.

Sasha - PartnerOps: CloudChannel confirms they didn’t get the SKU update in their marketplace mapping feed until 2026-02-12 — vendor-side delay. They’re asking for a one-off credit for Feb only.

Ben (FIN): Proposal: approve one-off credit of $2,466.25 to reconcile Feb mismap. GL: 5999-COGS, reason: marketplace SKU mapping error (partner mapping lag). Approver: Ben (FIN) + Raj (Revenue). Noah — block payment until credit applied.

Noah (Acct): Confirmed — holding payment. Will need credit memos + partner ledger entry before we release.

Raj - Revenue: I approve. Raj - Revenue (approver). Please include a short note referencing PO #CC-PILOT-01 and attach CloudChannel acknowledgement.

Ben (FIN): Approved. Emma, Sasha — please send the credit note to CloudChannel and upload the signed acknowledgement to /contracts/partners/CloudChannel/credit_43021_ack.pdf. :white_check_mark:

Emma L.: Will send now and cc AP. Tagging @Sasha for final partner acknowledgement.

Sasha - PartnerOps: Sent to partner — they replied OK to credit, will sign and return EOD. I uploaded the signed ack to the contracts folder when it comes back.

invoice-bot: AP ticket AP-2026-112 updated: credit memo pending.

Ben (FIN): Once credit memo is attached, Noah — please release payment and post GL. Thanks everyone.

Noah (Acct): Will do after upload. ETA 48 hours once doc is in the folder.
